title: Fishmate
description:
Aker QRILL Company is a world leader in the sustainable production of krill-based products. We are dedicated to enhancing the nutritional value of feed for aquaculture and livestock and contributing to a more sustainable global food system. Our business has experienced consistent growth within the Aker BioMarine organization. In 2024, we were spun out as a stand-alone entity, and we remain a reputable company in the maritime industry known for a focus on operational excellence. Working with us means you appreciate diversity, are highly skilled within your field, and can cope with unexpected situations. You enjoy a fast pace, tolerate quick decisions, and adapt to ongoing changes. You are a true team player who "chips in" when the situation requires so.

We are now looking for a Fishmate who will work on board our vessels in Antarctica.

Job Purpose

The Fishmate is responsible for all fishing operations during their shift. The work takes place on the bridge, with 12-hour shifts. If requested, the Fishmate must assist on deck.

Responsibilities During Operation

  • Responsible for fishing operations while on duty.
  • In command of the deck crew during deck operations related to fishery while on duty.
  • Assist in reporting as required by the Captain.
  • Assist the 1st officer with radio equipment.

Safety Responsibilities

  • Familiar with duties according to the "station bill" and muster lists for life rafts.
  • Ensure all measures are taken to perform safe operations on deck.
  • Wear safety equipment as required.
  • Ensure all crew wear safety equipment during operations.
  • Comply fully with the company's HSE MS system, national and international rules, and current regulations onboard.
  • Participate in drills such as MEDEVAC, oil pollution, firefighting, MOB, and abandon ship.
  • Actively participate in HSE meetings and programs, report events, etc.

Other Tasks

  • Perform additional tasks as requested by the Captain and Chief Officer.
  • Learn and understand how to use ERP systems as required.

Personal Qualifications

  • Desire for an offshore career.
  • English language skills.
  • Enjoys working in an international team.
  • Appreciates new challenges, seeks new tasks, and aims for continuous improvement.
  • Systematic, responsible, driven, and self-motivated.

We Offer

  • A safe and attractive workplace.
  • Opportunity for a fixed position onboard.
  • Fixed annual salary.
  • Good working environment onboard.
  • Pension and insurance scheme.
  • 12/7 shift schedule: 12 hours on, 12 hours off, 7 days a week, with about 150 sea days per year and 120-135 days off between trips.
  • Shift rotation includes approximately three months at sea with travel, followed by time off, with embarkation/disembarkation in ports in Uruguay, Chile, and the Falkland Islands.

Location

Vessel/Antarctica

Application and Contact

If this sounds like an exciting opportunity, please apply via the provided link. We will contact candidates on an ongoing basis. Send your application letter and CV in English or Norwegian to .

About Aker QRILL Company

We develop ingredients for aquaculture, animal feed, and human health supplements. Our operations include vessels in Antarctica, logistics in Montevideo, and global customers. We operate a fleet of four vessels, including one cargo and three fishing vessels, with year-round krill harvesting in Antarctica. Our offices are in Fornebu and Ålesund, with a logistics hub in Montevideo. We are a diverse company with over 25 nationalities, fostering an international, high-performing, and fun work environment.

Working with us means valuing diversity, being highly skilled, and capable of handling unexpected situations. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, make quick decisions, and adapt to ongoing changes. You are a team player who "chips in" when needed.

QRILL Aqua is a functional feed ingredient for shrimp, marine fish, and salmonids, enhancing productivity through improved growth, health, and quality.

QRILL Pet is a functional ingredient for pet nutrition with proven health benefits for companion animals, supporting heart, kidney, liver, joint, brain, eye, skin, and coat health.

Why join our team?

Expect hard work, fun, and challenges. We promise an exciting journey, with opportunities for initiative and responsibility. We believe our team strives to do their best, aiming to be industry leaders and continually raise standards.

  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys.

title: Quality Controller
description:
Aker QRILL Company is a world leader in the sustainable production of krill-based products. We are dedicated to enhancing the nutritional value of feed for aquaculture and livestock and contributing to a more sustainable global food system. Our business has experienced consistent growth within the Aker BioMarine organization. In 2024 we were spun out as a stand-alone entity, and we remain a reputable company in the maritime industry known for a focus on operational excellence.

We are now looking for two Quality Controllers who will work on board our vessels in Antarctica

Quality Controller

QC is overall responsible and in charge of all product quality controls and quality systems on board the vessel. Included are control of products and production lines. Furthermore, responsible for maintaining and operating the laboratory, as well as maintenance and ordering spare parts for components/instruments involved in the QC department and for follow up HSE strategy and HACCAP on board the vessel.

Responsibility during operation

  • Overall responsible for all QC procedures in the Factory department
  • Good knowledge of all production procedures and ensure that they are followed.
  • Follow up and archive GMP relevant training records according to Competence Matrix
  • If applicable follow up QC assistant
  • Responsible for internal audits during operation
  • Perform inspections of cleaning
  • Identify and report possible improvements related to production, safety, sampling, analysis etc.
  • Ordering of consumables for QC lab, using the purchasing ERP system
  • Ensure that QC lab inventory is kept up to date.
  • Report to Bridge and Main Office as required
  • Report in ShipAdmin as required
  • Create handover notes for oncoming QC

Safety responsibility

  • HSE representative
  • Secretary for all HSE meetings. The position is a link between all crew members and Captain related to HSE issues.
  • Call for HSE meetings on regular intervals or when needed.
  • Take part in regular sanitary inspections and Safety Officers inspection of safety equipment. Sign documents from inspections.
  • Forward comments from such inspections to Captain and DPA
  • Be familiar with duties according to "station bill" and muster lists for life rafts.
  • Wear safety equipment as required.
  • HSE MS: Comply fully with the requirements in the Company’s HSE MS system, national as well as international rules and legislations and other precautions currently valid on board.
  • Drills: According to “Emergency Plan”
  • HSE Activities: Actively take part in HSE meetings and programs, event reporting etc.

Desired characteristics

  • Experience from working at sea is preferred
  • Structured and able to work independently
  • Accurate and conscientious
  • Good communication skills both verbal and in writing, English is work language
  • Positive mind-set, solution-oriented
  • Enjoys new challenges.

Qualifications

  • Experience with laboratory work.
  • Education within laboratory, food technology or chemistry.
  • Desire to start an offshore career.
  • Have good English knowledge (AKBM`s work language).
  • Enjoy working in an international team.
  • Appreciate new challenges, seeking new tasks and continuous improvements.
  • Systematic and responsible with drive and self-motivation

We offer

  • A safe and attractive workplace
  • Fixed annual salary
  • Good working environment on board
  • Pension and insurance scheme
  • 12/7 shift; 12 hours on, 12 hours off, 7 days a week for the entire rotation
  • Shift rotation: One shift on; approx. 85 days and two shifts off, averaging 150 sea days per year and about 120 - 130 days off between trips. Travel to and from fishing ground is about one week each way at the beginning and the end of the rotation, using ports in Uruguay, Chile, and Falkland Islands for embarkation on cargo and passenger vessel, bringing crew to fishing vessels on fishing ground.

Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? Please don't hesitate to apply as we will be contacting candidates on an ongoing basis.

Please send your application letter and CV in either English or Norwegian via the application link. Questions may be directed to .

About Aker QRILL Company:

We develop ingredients for use in the aquaculture and animal feed markets, as well as deliver raw materials for production of human health supplements. Our value chain stretches from our vessels and sustainable krill harvesting operations in Antarctica, through our logistics hub in Montevideo, and all the way to customers around the world.

The Company operates a fleet of four vessels, including one cargo vessel and three fishing vessels, leading krill fishing within the Antarctic region. The three fishing vessels operate on the fishing grounds year-round, except for one month in October, which is dedicated to maintenance and repairs while the cargo vessel transports products and crew to and from the fishing grounds throughout the year.

Our offices are located in Fornebu and Ålesund, with the logistics base and product warehouse in Montevideo, Uruguay. We are about 500 employees globally, of which about 430 work on board our krill vessels in Antarctica. We are a diverse company with more than 25 nationalities, spread across all time zones and most continents. Together, we form an international, high performing, diverse and fun work environment.

Working with us means you appreciate diversity, are highly skilled within your field and can cope with unexpected situations. You enjoy a fast pace, tolerate quick decisions and continuously ongoing changes. You are a true team player who “chips in” when the situation requires so.

QRILL Aqua is a functional feed ingredient for shrimp, marine fish, and salmonids, increasing productivity in aquaculture - through improved growth, health and quality.

QRILL Pet is a functional ingredient for pet nutrition with documented health benefits for companion animals. Proven in numerous studies to benefit pet health, the omega-3s help maintain the health of the heart, kidneys, liver, joints, brain, eyes, skin and coat.

Why should you be part of our team?

You can expect hard work and a lot of fun and challenges. In return we promise you will be part of an exciting journey. If you show initiative and desire for more responsibility, we will give it to you and support you along the way. We strongly believe that our team of people want to do their best. All in the spirit of being the leading company in our industry and always striving to raise the bar.

title: Lead Concept Artist
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a talented Lead Concept Artist to help us continue shaping the future of Fortnite. We are searching for an experienced artist to support and supervise creative content provided by artists. Reporting to the individual art team director and working with the Outsource Manager, the Lead Concept Artist will provide front-line creative feedback for work submitted for Epic review. Though the role will be mainly supervisory, we are looking for an experienced Concept Artist with a solid hands-on art background who has worked in game studio pipelines before. The ideal candidate would be a talented artist who is able to communicate with artists, including documenting existing pipelines, collecting or creating quality bar and technical example assets, collecting photo references, creating mood boards, creating paint overs, and finally collaborating with other teams at Epic to ensure that concept art is of the highest quality and adequately supports the needs of those teams and the project.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with the individual Art Leads, Art Directors, and Outsource Manager(s) on the team to support internal artists
  • Collect or generate detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support the artists
  • If required, make any needed fixes to keep assets consistent and technically game ready
  • Clearly communicate feedback to the artists, and ensure those creative notes and goals are met, and inform leadership in the event that isn’t happening
  • Communicate and partner with internal Epic art staff to ensure that concept art is clear and respects limitations from other disciplines
  • When required, some amount of hands-on art production to deliver concepts for the project, ensuring they are familiar and capable working alongside other Epic artists

What we're looking for

  • Worked on at least one AAA game in a Senior/Lead Concept Artist role
  • Experience working with intellectual properties
  • A portfolio that demonstrates a range of styles, creativity, and craftsmanship
  • Effective communicator, collaborator, and problem solver able to coordinate between internal and external teams and deliver clear and concise feedback
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to accurately estimate tasks and maintain schedules
  • Understanding of other game art disciplines, their workflows, and limitations (animation, character, environment, VFX)
  • You’re user-focused, passionate, solutions-focused, and innovative. These traits equal success at Epic and influence everything we do
  • A PLUS - Fluency in a language other than English, including Chinese, German, Spanish, Italian, or Russian

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

description:
Aker QRILL Company is a world leader in the sustainable production of krill-based products. We are dedicated to enhancing the nutritional value of feed for aquaculture and livestock and contributing to a more sustainable global food system. Our business has experienced consistent growth within the Aker BioMarine organization. In 2024 we were spun out as a stand-alone entity, and we remain a reputable company in the maritime industry known for a focus on operational excellence. Working with us means you appreciate diversity, are highly skilled within your field and can cope with unexpected situations. You enjoy a fast pace, tolerate quick decisions and continuously ongoing changes. You are a true team player who “chips in” when the situation requires so.

We are now looking for Electricians who will work on board our vessels in Antarctica.

Electrician is overall responsible for the administration and maintenance of all electrical/ electronic installations, machinery automation, navigation, communication system onboard and ordering of spare parts for these components. He/she is also responsible for, and being sure costs are held at or below budgets.

Responsibilities:

• Maintenance of all electrical equipment
• Preventive maintenance of all electrical equipment
• Cyber Security matters
• Order spares using the purchasing ERP system
• Keep inventory up to date at all time
• Make reports as required and requested
• Create hand over notes to oncoming Electrician
• Make weekly reports
• Report in ShipAdmin
• Supervise the Electrician Assistant

Qualifications:

  • Certified ETR/ETO
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience
  • Fluent in English both verbally and in written form
  • Positive and driven attitude

Desired characteristics:

  • Desire for an offshore career
  • Enjoys working in an international environment
  • Appreciates new challenges, seeking new tasks and continuous improvements
  • Systematic and responsible with drive and self-motivation

Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? Please don't hesitate to apply as we will be contacting candidates on an ongoing basis.

Please send your application letter and CV in either English or Norwegian via the application link. Questions may be directed to .

About Aker QRILL Company:

We develop ingredients for use in the aquaculture and animal feed markets, as well as deliver raw materials for production of human health supplements. Our value chain stretches from our vessels and sustainable krill harvesting operations in Antarctica, through our logistics hub in Montevideo, and all the way to customers around the world.

The Company operates a fleet of four vessels, including one cargo vessel and three fishing vessels, leading krill fishing within the Antarctic region. The three fishing vessels operate on the fishing grounds year-round, except for one month in October, which is dedicated to maintenance and repairs while the cargo vessel transports products and crew to and from the fishing grounds throughout the year.

Our offices are located in Fornebu and Ålesund, with the logistics base and product warehouse in Montevideo, Uruguay. We are about 500 employees globally, of which about 430 work on board our krill vessels in Antarctica. We are a diverse company with more than 25 nationalities, spread across all time zones and most continents. Together, we form an international, high performing, diverse and fun work environment.

Working with us means you appreciate diversity, are highly skilled within your field and can cope with unexpected situations. You enjoy a fast pace, tolerate quick decisions and continuously ongoing changes. You are a true team player who “chips in” when the situation requires so.

QRILL Aqua is a functional feed ingredient for shrimp, marine fish, and salmonids, increasing productivity in aquaculture - through improved growth, health and quality.

QRILL Pet is a functional ingredient for pet nutrition with documented health benefits for companion animals. Proven in numerous studies to benefit pet health, the omega-3s help maintain the health of the heart, kidneys, liver, joints, brain, eyes, skin and coat.

You can expect hard work and a lot of fun and challenges. In return we promise you will be part of an exciting journey. If you show initiative and desire for more responsibility, we will give it to you and support you along the way. We strongly believe that our team of people want to do their best. All in the spirit of being the leading company in our industry and always striving to raise the bar.

title: Data Engineer Manager
description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

We are seeking a talented and passionate Data Engineer – Generalist to join our dynamic team. In this role, you’ll leverage modern technologies to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines while contributing to organizational best practices. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and have a knack for innovative problem-solving, we’d love to hear from you.

Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting the Data Engineering team lead in ensuring quality and agility across team activities.
  • Collaborating with fellow data engineers to design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines using leading-edge technologies.
  • Building and maintaining data pipelines that integrate diverse data sources into a Harmonized Data Mesh for both internal and external use.
  • Debugging, unit testing, and deploying data pipelines while optimizing their performance.
  • Managing metadata associated with data and processes to ensure consistency and compliance.
  • Documenting and versioning code to maintain transparency and scalability.
  • Promoting Data Engineering best practices and contributing to Enterprise Data Governance frameworks.
  • Partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative, high-quality engineering solutions that meet evolving business needs.
  • Driving continuous improvement in test development, automation, and release processes.
  • Advocating for user-centric design and functionality when collaborating with product, design, and technical teams.

What You’ll Need

  • Experience:
  • Relevant experience in Data Engineering
  • Hands-on experience with cloud computing platforms, preferably Azure.
  • Proficiency in modern data storage systems (e.g., Data Lake, Delta Lake, Lakehouse).
  • Expertise in developing data pipelines using PySpark, Scala, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience working with Big Data platforms, such as Databricks.
  • Advanced knowledge of relational/transactional databases and SQL.
  • Strong skills in performance tuning for PySpark and SQL workflows.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines.
  • Skills:
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to adapt to diverse audiences.
  • Passion for innovation and collaboration in a fast-paced environment.
  • Mindset:
  • Proactive and self-motivated with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Creative thinker who enjoys solving complex problems.
  • Team-oriented and adaptable to shifting priorities.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a collaborative, innovative team shaping the future of data engineering in ABI.
  • Opportunities to work with cutting-edge tools and technologies.
  • A supportive culture that values creativity, diversity, and continuous learning.
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance*

title: Software Dev Engineer, Game-Based Learning
description:
Software Dev Engineer, Game-Based Learning

AWS Game-Based Learning Products is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join a fast-paced, startup-minded innovation team where fun is an integral part of your job. Joining our team, you will collaborate with a team of architects, artists, designers, engineers, and testers responsible for the conception, development and operations of highly technical game-based learning solutions that rely on extensive use of hands-on labs, virtual environments, and interactive simulations to get customers to develop practical skills using AWS services.
As a Software Development Engineer, you will partner with fellow backend engineers to build cloud services platforms that are foundational to our games; you will collaborate with Unity3d engineers to create rich gameplays; you will cooperate with designers and artists to develop a compelling end-to-end visual gaming experience; and you will assist learning architects and instructional designers map learning objectives and game elements to deliver a unique cloud learning experience to our players.
For more information about some of our products:
- job responsibilities
- Collaborate with a multi-disciplinary team of architects, artists, designers, engineers, and testers to design, deliver, maintain, and operate multiple game-based learning products;
- Drive our system architecture and promote best practices to produce high quality games, and coach less tenured engineers;
- Partner with technical and business stakeholders to influence our long-term strategy and establish the team's roadmap;
- Make data-driven decisions by leveraging industry landscape from engineering, gaming and training, as well as user feedback and telemetry data;
- Write high quality code.
A day in the life
You will work with engineering and product stakeholders closely on a day-to-day basis. You will contribute to the production of multiple games and features and collaborate with other learning products teams (e.g.: AWS SkillBuilder, AWS Labs, AWS Jam, Exam Prep). You will solve, learn, and mentor team members on web-scale challenges, distributed systems problems, and game development best practices. You will regularly review technical work with peers, stakeholders, and leadership.
About the team
AWS Game-Based Learning team members are spread across the US, Canada, and Brazil. Our mission is to build learning products that use game thinking principles. We combine learning strategies with game technologies and theories to develop appealing knowledge transfer experiences that target customer needs.
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
- Ability to communicate in English and Portuguese (verbal and written)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Experience in Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops)
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

We are looking for a skilled and versatile Tech Manager Developer to join our growing team. In this role, you’ll contribute to designing, building, and maintaining innovative software solutions. You will work across various functions, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable, and user-focused solutions.

Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating with teams to design and develop features for global products that meet business and user needs.
  • Driving improvements in architecture, code quality, and overall development practices.
  • Actively engaging in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews.
  • Conducting design and code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices.
  • Partnering with colleagues to build and maintain tools for test development, automation, and release process improvements.
  • Advocating for user experience when collaborating with product, design, and technical teams.
  • Coaching and mentoring team members to foster a culture of continuous learning and growth.
  • Debugging, testing, and optimizing code to enhance performance and maintainability.
  • Developing and maintaining scalable, data-driven applications with a focus on quality and reliability.

What You’ll Need

  • Proven experience in software development, including server-side and backend development.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Java, C#, or similar.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
  • Solid understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS) and DevOps tools like Kubernetes and Docker.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and database optimization (e.g., SQL Server, T-SQL).
  • Knowledge of testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, XUnit) and automation tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies like Scrum or Kanban.
  • Proficiency in source control systems such as Git/GitHub.
  • Passionate about software development and continuously improving processes.
  • Motivated by building impactful solutions that reach millions of users.
  • Adaptable to dynamic environments with shifting priorities.
  • Creative thinker with a focus on collaboration and teamwork.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a collaborative, innovative team that values creativity and diversity.
  • Opportunities to work with cutting-edge tools and technologies.
  • A culture that fosters professional growth, learning, and mentorship.
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance*

title: Firmware Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Firmware QA Analyst, you will take on the crucial responsibility of ensuring the quality, functionality, and reliability of our firmware products. You’ll serve as the last line of defense, protecting our customers from potential headaches and ensuring they experience only the best our technology has to offer. In this role, you will not only test and validate firmware but also champion a culture of continuous improvement across the organization. Your attention to detail and commitment to excellence will make you an advocate for firmware enhancements, driving our innovation forward. This is your opportunity to make a direct impact on the satisfaction of our customers and the success of our products.


Responsibilities
  • Building and Managing Test Environments: Design, implement, and maintain test environments to simulate real-world scenarios, ensuring thorough validation of firmware functionality and performance.
  • Developing and Automating Test Scripts: Create and maintain unit and automated test scripts to validate individual firmware modules and overall system behavior, ensuring comprehensive test coverage.
  • Documenting Testing Processes: Develop and maintain detailed documentation for test strategies, plans, cases, and methodologies, establishing clear and consistent testing guidelines across the team.
  • Integrating Testing into CI/CD Pipelines: Collaborate with the development team to embed automated testing into the CI/CD pipeline, enabling frequent and reliable testing for continuous delivery of high-quality firmware.
  • Ensuring Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with QA and development teams to identify and address testing gaps, improving processes and ensuring timely, high-quality releases.
  • Driving Firmware Quality Improvements: Act as a key stakeholder in the firmware lifecycle, advocating for quality-first approaches and ensuring the final product meets customer expectations and industry standards.
Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience working with electronics or firmware engineering.
  • Familiarity with data acquisition, processing, and logging techniques for embedded testing purposes.
  • Understanding of data analysis methods and their application in firmware testing.
  • Proficiency with development tools such as VSCode and GitHub.
  • Hands-on experience with scripting languages, including Python and MATLAB.
  • Knowledge of embedded systems, with the ability to integrate modules and customize test equipment or environments.
  • Familiarity with the C programming language.
  • Practical experience working with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, DAQs, multimeters, and power supplies.
Bonus Points
  • Familiarity with test implementations in a TDD or BDD environment.
  • Familiarity with C++ programming language.
  • Experience with firmware concepts, like RTOS, HAL, and other drivers.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, for CI/CD implementations.
  • Excellent analytical skills.

Your responsibilities will include building and maintaining dashboards, analyzing workforce trends, and partnering with key stakeholders to optimize our workforce strategy.

What you'll need

  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or Looker).
  • Solid understanding of HR systems (HRIS) and how they integrate with financial data.
  • Excellent analytical skills with a strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

Nice to have

  • Understanding of global payroll and labor cost structures.

More about you

  • You’re passionate about solving problems and are continuously seeking improvements;

Bunge has an exciting opportunity available for a Data Scientist. In this role, you will be part of a global team working on challenging, meaningful projects impacting core business activities. Since 1818, Bunge has been connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology, and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster, and simpler way. Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world – creating world-class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate, test, and learn to succeed.

At Bunge, people do not just come here to work; they come here to grow – solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers. Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package, generous paid time off, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for career progression. Our hybrid work environment provides a balance of in-office and remote work.

Most importantly, in all we do, we live our values:

  • Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect
  • Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative, and efficient
  • Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably

Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Data Scientist with strong expertise in predictive and prescriptive modeling applied to industrial operations. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be responsible for constructing models to solve business problems, communicating with technical teams, and ensuring delivery aligns with business expectations. You will also work with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize data analytics initiatives.

Main Accountabilities

  • Design, create, test, and implement complex models and algorithms that drive analytical solutions across the organization.
  • Provide technical support for data scientists across multiple squads.
  • Collaborate with business analysts to understand problems and implement scalable solutions.
  • Define development standards and solution approaches.
  • Design and structure reusable codebases.
  • Coordinate with MIS, Digital Specialists, and Data Engineers to deliver comprehensive analytical solutions.
  • Communicate the design, functioning, and output of analytical models/solutions.
  • Ensure timely analysis and testing for maintenance of solutions.
  • Present data insights to stakeholders.

Knowledge and Technical Competencies

  • Make decisions aligned with Bunge’s strategy, business needs, and financial goals, exploring new perspectives through innovation.
  • Build strong relationships, influence others, and develop talent.
  • Develop data-driven strategies aligned with company priorities and communicate effectively.
  • Proficient in data science, machine learning, programming languages like Python or R, SQL, data analysis, teamwork, and communication skills.
  • Assist in structuring problems/hypotheses and translating them into advanced analytics approaches, including machine learning and optimization.
  • Help business understand data science and optimization concepts for better cross-functional communication.

Education/Experience

  • Advanced knowledge in mathematics, analytics, and computer science, including machine learning, statistical models, and data science programming.
  • Avoid logical flaws, build resilient data pipelines in cloud environments, and prepare high-quality data.
  • Mentor associates and data scientists, and communicate effectively with stakeholders and management.
  • Model behavior as a team player and foster new ideas.

Bunge (NYSE: BG) is a global leader in sourcing, processing, and supplying oilseed and grain products and ingredients. Founded in 1818, Bunge’s network supports over 70,000 farmers and consumers worldwide, with headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri, and 25,000 employees globally, operating numerous facilities and terminals.

title: Senior Industrial Automation Implementation
description:
Customer at TRACTIAN

The Customer team is the driving factor behind lifetime value, retention and expasion at Tractian. We focus on expanding inside existing customers, crosselling to different products, and building even stronger relationships with our current accounts. Our Enterprise customers are comprised of Fortune 500 companies, such as Hyundai, Bosch, Unilever, Suzano, PepsiCo, and others. Every member of our team directly affects the results of our clients. As part of this team, you will be in contact with clients to understand their needs and help create solutions to improve their maintenance processes.

What you'll do

As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for reviewing and optimizing technical proposals to ensure alignment with the company’s capabilities and technical requirements, supporting the proper field installation and system integration. You will manage the implementation process, including the integration of sensors, PLCs, and frequency inverters, ensuring that the solutions are robust, scalable, and meet client demands. Additionally, you will oversee the go-live phase, validate system functionality, and provide post-implementation technical support.


Responsibilities
  • Review and adjust technical proposals developed by the Sales team, ensuring they align with the company's capabilities and the required technical specifications, thereby supporting the technical implementation and correct field installation;
  • Verify the compatibility of system integrations (sensors, PLCs, Frequency Inverters, etc.) within the client’s environment, ensuring that the solutions are robust and scalable;
  • Participate in client meetings to better understand their demands and translate these needs into viable technical solutions;
  • Manage the implementation schedule, ensuring that the stages are completed within the established deadlines and that the system functions properly;
  • Supervise the application and go-live phase of the implemented systems, validating the correct functioning of sensors, PLCs, and monitoring systems;
  • Work closely with the Data Science, Hardware, and Platform teams to develop, optimize, and implement features that add value to the solutions;
  • Provide post-implementation technical support, helping to resolve technical issues or make adjustments when necessary;
  • Collaborate with other teams in the company, such as Technical Support and Product Engineering, to ensure that the developed solutions are aligned with the company's capabilities and innovations;
  • Help identify opportunities for upsell or additional improvements in projects, based on technical understanding and customer feedback.
Requirements
  • +5 Years of Industrial Experience, preferably with a background in Industrial Automation and Project Management;
  • Familiarity with handling and programming (Ladder Logic) various PLC brands (Siemens, Allen-Bradley/Rockwell, Schneider Electric, Mitsubishi, etc.);
  • Experience with SCADA, DCS, or other supervisory and control systems;
  • Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, EtherNet/IP, Profibus, or OPC UA for sensor and controller integration;
  • Experience with instrumentation and sensor sizing (level, pressure, flow, humidity, etc.);
  • Ability to work with measurement and control systems for electrical and mechanical variables;
  • Willingness to travel to client plants and ability to conduct technical demonstration meetings;
  • Managing technical projects (scope, implementation schedule, technical sizing, and structural review) alongside the Sales team;
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with exceptional ability to present solutions to complex problems.
Bonus Points
  • CMVP Certification;

Como um membro da nossa equipe comercial, você vai atuar com vendas de equipamentos médicos em um ambiente altamente profissional e de grande velocidade. Principais Responsabilidades

  1. Atingir metas mensais, trimestrais e quotas anuais de vendas.

  3. Maximizar o número de unidades vendidas por semana e mês, operando dentro de preços de mercado pré-fixados.

  1. Formação Superior completa em Administração de Empresas ou ligada à área de Saúde.

  11. Alta performance para alcançar as métricas de desempenho da empresa, tais como crescimento e receita.
  12. Capacidade comprovada em atuar de forma eficiente e eficaz na qualificação e desenvolvimento de oportunidades de vendas, a fim de concluir vendas.

  14. Habilidade para vender de forma eficaz e profissional, em um ambiente de vendas de alto dinamismo, muitas mudanças e alta competitividade.
  15. Habilidade como usuário de Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel e PowerPoint.

  20. Esforçar-se para a melhorias constantes; inspirar e motivar os outros.
  21. Representar a organização de uma forma altamente profissional.

Agente Stone - Consultor(a) Comercial Externo | Passo Fundo/RS

Passo Fundo, Rio Grande Do Sul, Brasil

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  1. Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  2. Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
  3. No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
  4. Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  5. The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O maior diferencial da Stone é ser uma companhia totalmente centrada no cliente. E para garantir que o(a) empreendedor(ra) foque no crescimento do seu negócio, construímos escritórios próprios (polos) por todo o Brasil, entregando presencialmente as soluções mais eficazes do mercado.

Nosso time de Agentes Stone está todos os dias lado a lado da nossa razão, os donos e donas de negócio, apoiando cada um deles em sua jornada empreendedora, garantindo total comprometimento em resolver os seus problemas e a melhor experiência de atendimento ao(à) cliente do país.

Como é ser um(a) Consultor Comercial Externo:

Seu papel será entender profundamente as necessidades do(a) cliente e conectá-las às nossas soluções financeiras com muita empatia, conhecimento sobre o mercado e encantamento.

  • Jornada de trabalho: Segunda a Sexta | 44h semanais.
  • Gerenciar a carteira de clientes mantendo um relacionamento contínuo e pós-venda.
  • Participar das matinais diárias para traçar os seus planos, metas e trocas de aprendizados.
  • Entregar um atendimento de excelência ao nosso cliente.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Ser maior de idade.
  • Desejável experiência comercial.
  • Saber se comunicar muito bem.
  • Muita energia e paixão por servir o nosso cliente.
  • Buscar a excelência em tudo que se propor a fazer.

Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta: médicos, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, na palma da sua mão
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Sodexo
  • Auxílio Creche - para crianças até 5 anos e 11 meses
  • Vale Transporte ou Auxílio Combustível
  • Salário Fixo e Variável + Bônus trimestral (quando preenchidos os requisitos)
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e video aulas (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

  • Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
  • Questionário de Vida: Este é o momento de te conhecermos! Você deverá preencher um questionário com o objetivo de apresentar sua trajetória, hobbies, motivações e sonhos.
  • Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
  • Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.
  • Rota Teste: Nosso objetivo é que você vivencie a rotina proposta na vaga na prática, ou seja, você acompanhará um(a) dos(as) nossos(as) agentes durante a sua rota.
  • Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.
  • Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

  • Drive the business strategy by providing insights into current performance and highlighting areas of opportunity for growth. To do this, conduct advanced data analysis, statistical modeling, and machine learning models to answer specific business questions, extract insights and predictive patterns from large datasets to explain and expose potential opportunities from the data.

title: GESTOR DE NEGOCIOS I
description:
Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga

  1. Relacionamento comercial com a carteira de produtores de menor tamanho (hectares) na região;
  2. Originação (compra) de Soja e Milho para cumprir o programa de exportação e esmagamento (portos e fabricas);
  3. Executar atividades relacionadas aos controles diários da filial;
  4. Acompanhar o Mercado Agrícola via conexão com a Mesa Trading da Regional e Corretores;
  5. Financiamento ao produtor (Custeio de Safra): análise e defesa do crédito (Web Data Base), acompanhamento para constituição das garantias (penhor/hipoteca);

Qualificações

  1. Superior completo em Agronomia ou áreas afins;
  2. Vivência na comercialização de grãos e operações de Barter;
  3. Experiência com softwares de gestão comercial - CRM;

Informações adicionais

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

title: Hardware Test Engineer - Electronics
description:
Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Hardware Test Engineer for Electronics, you will be deeply involved in the electrical testing of hardware components and systems. Your expertise will be essential in executing a variety of electrical tests, from component-level analysis to system-wide functionality checks, ensuring all electronic products meet technical specifications and performance criteria.


Responsibilities
  • Design and conduct electrical tests such as signal integrity, power loading, and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) using oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, and network analyzers.
  • Implement embedded firmware for microcontrollers to simulate operational conditions for electronic testing.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot circuitry issues using multimeters, logic analyzers, and in-circuit emulators.
  • Collaborate with design engineers to refine PCB layouts and circuit designs based on test findings.
  • Document all test results and develop reports that outline findings, conclusions, and recommendations for improvements.
  • Stay current with advancements in electronic testing equipment and techniques.
  • Adhere to and enforce compliance with electronic safety standards and regulations.
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience with hands-on electronic hardware testing and debugging.
  • Strong proficiency with electronic test equipment and diagnostic tools.
  • Knowledge of printed circuit board (PCB) design and testing, including familiarity with EDA tools like KiCad or Altium Designer.
  • Solid understanding of digital and analog circuitry, as well as experience with power electronics.
  • Ability to read and interpret electronic schematics and datasheets.
Bonus Points
  • Experience with RF testing and wireless communications standards.
  • Involvement in open-source hardware projects or community electronics groups.
  • Fluent in English.

  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;

  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);

description:
Marketing at TRACTIAN

The Tractian Marketing team bridges the gap between our innovative products and the technical audience we serve, combining Growth, Branding, and Product Marketing to reach and resonate with both prospects and customers. Our team collaborates deeply with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to ensure our visual identity and messaging reflect Tractian expertise and commitment to operational excellence.

As a Sr. Creative Designer, you will play a key role in shaping our brand’s visual identity and leading the creative direction within the Creative Core Team. You will act as the main technical reference for the design team, mentoring designers, ensuring top-quality creative execution, and driving high-impact projects that align with our business objectives. description:

A Thymos Capital é uma assessoria financeira e estratégica, dedicada a toda a cadeia do setor elétrico, atendendo geradoras, transmissoras, distribuidoras e comercializadoras. A integração à Thymos Energia, consultoria referência no setor elétrico, proporciona o suporte de uma equipe de mais de 60 analistas altamente especializados nesse mercado.

Buscamos um Especialista de M&A (Associate - Fusões e Aquisições), interessado em atuar em uma das maiores empresas brasileiras de consultoria e gestão de energia.

  • Elaboração de valuation e apresentações de companhias e novos investimentos;
  • Análise de dados para novas oportunidades;
  • Auxílio no processo de diligência e revisão de relatórios;
  • Análise de empresas para operações de M&A (Fusões e Aquisições), novos negócios e/ou desinvestimentos;
  • Participação em reuniões com times de executivos, empreendedores e clientes;
  • Execução de atividades internas e rotinas de suporte ao negócio;
  • Construção de storytelling e apresentações em Power Point para o negócio.
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência com M&A no setor de Energia;
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito);
  • Excel avançado;
  • Conhecimento avançado em finanças corporativas e modelagem financeira.

Alguns dos nossos benefícios:

- Plano de saúde subsidiado pela empresa (sem coparticipação);

- Vale refeição;

- Vale alimentação;

- Valorização da saúde e bem-estar | grupo de corrida e/ou ciclismo (EQ Performance);

- Wellhub;

  • Step 3: Entrevista com o Gestor 3 Entrevista com o Gestor

A Thymos foi fundada em janeiro de 2013 com o objetivo de contribuir com o avanço do setor de energia em termos de gestão e eficiência. Um seleto grupo de profissionais decidiu investir em conhecimento – requisito fundamental para balizar a modernização do setor elétrico e para promover o desenvolvimento de mercados de energia elétrica e gás natural estruturados, baseados na livre concorrência, capazes de dinamizar a economia nacional e impulsionar o crescimento econômico do Brasil.

Hoje, a Thymos oferece soluções de ponta a ponta da cadeia: geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização e consumo, além de orientar investidores que buscam oportunidades nesses segmentos. Seus profissionais deram suporte à negociação de mais de 6.000 MWmédios em processos de compra de curto, médio e longo prazos em 2019 e gerenciam mensalmente mais de 2.000 MWmédios de energia para consumidores, geradores e distribuidoras.

A Thymos Energia conta com excelente infraestrutura para oferecer ao mercado seus principais serviços – consultoria em energia, gestão de energia, pesquisa e desenvolvimento – com seriedade e competência. Seus estudos bem fundamentados, a alta qualidade técnica de seus projetos, relatórios e análises de mercado e a excelente interlocução da equipe com os mais diversos órgãos e entidades do setor são os marcos de uma trajetória de sucesso.

O setor de energia ainda tem muito a avançar e apresenta grandes desafios. Nos novos cenários que vêm surgindo, os estudos técnicos, as pesquisas e análise, as projeções e antecipações de tendência serão ainda mais importantes para agentes, investidores e para a sociedade. Os profissionais da Thymos estarão aqui, prontos para contribuir com o futuro do setor.

title: Pessoa Operadora de Produção I Exclusiva Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência - Igrejinha/RS
description:
Título: Pessoa Operadora de Produção I - Exclusiva Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência

Local: Igrejinha-RS (Presencial)

Venha fazer parte do nosso time de estrelas!

Somos o Grupo HEINEKEN, lugar de gente que cultiva relações respeitosas com as nossas pessoas, sociedade e planeta. Levamos no coração o #OrgulhoHEINEKEN que reflete a paixão pela nossa história e pela qualidade indiscutível das nossas bebidas.

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e sabemos que um time formado por pessoas com perfis diversos nos torna tão fortes e únicos quanto nossas marcas. Queremos inspirar e fazer parte da transformação de um mundo melhor para todas as pessoas. Não só para algumas. Esse é o nosso melhor e mais importante brinde!

Aqui, nos desafiamos a ser melhores todos os dias, buscando inovação e agilidade, para levar nossa estrela em cada coração e em cada copo brasileiro. E claro, nos divertimos na mesma proporção celebrando todas as nossas conquistas.

E ai, se identificou? Se você tem coragem para abraçar novos desafios e está a fim de fazer a diferença, vamos juntos transformar o mercado de bebidas. Acesse nossas oportunidades!

Seu brilho transforma a nossa estrela!

Missão Cargo

Responsável pela operação, inspeção e limpeza dos equipamentos industriais da área de processo de fabricação, visando atender a todos os procedimentos operacionais, garantindo os requisitos de segurança e qualidade, evitando desperdícios e reduzindo custos operacionais.

Principais Atribuições

  • Operar e manter os equipamentos da área de processo de acordo com os procedimentos correspondentes;
  • Desenvolver fluência de conhecimento em operação e manutenção em pelo menos uma das áreas do processo;
  • Executar periodicamente inspeções no processo produtivo e no produto visando o controle e o registro dos parâmetros de qualidade de acordo com os padrões estabelecidos através do cumprimento das rotinas operacionais;
  • Realizar a operação de recebimento de matéria prima e CIP;
  • Realizar análises laboratoriais de controle para assegurar o perfeito andamento do processo produtivo, conforme determinação dos procedimentos operacionais;
  • Utiliza-se da metodologia de TPM como ferramenta de gestão do seu dia a dia, participando ativamente das reuniões de DCS, utilizando a ferramenta RCFA, e atua ativamente do time de gestão Autônoma da sua área de atuação;
  • Executar tarefas de organização e limpeza no seu local de trabalho através do cumprimento das rotinas operacionais do padrão, visando à manutenção do ambiente limpo, organizado e seguro;
  • Participa do processo de melhoria contínua dos indicadores de resultado do seu local de trabalho através da participação em times de melhoria contínua;
  • Realizar apontamentos de produção no sistema SAP, bem como abrir notas de manutenção neste sistema para anomalias encontradas em sua área de atuação;
  • Realizar restauração de condições básicas nos equipamentos de sua área de atuação;
  • Para membros da equipe de Segurança de Alimentos ESA, é de responsabilidade do mesmo o estudo de HACCP, sua execução, revisões e manutenção do sistema de acordo com procedimento PR-COR-TCP-075;
  • Realizar atividades referente aos PCC’s e PPRO’s conforme procedimento. Responsabilidade dos colaboradores que atuam em equipamentos/área que possuem PCC e PPRO.

Formação acadêmica

Ensino médio completo.

Diferencial estar cursando técnico: Qualidade, Química, Elétrica, Mecânica entre outros.

Benefícios

Temos profundo Cuidado com a sua saúde! Oferecemos Assistência Médica, Odontológica, Telemedicina, Cartão Farmácia, Seguro de Vida e Previdência Privada .

Está precisando de apoio psicológico, orientação jurídica ou financeira? Temos o programa ‘Conta Comigo’ com profissionais especializados para te atender 24 horas por dia.

E que tal pensar no seu bem-estar? Aproveite o Gympass para incluir atividades físicas na sua rotina.

Sua família está crescendo? Temos o Programa de Gestantes desenvolvido com muito carinho para você! Além disso, temos licença maternidade de 180 dias e paternidade de até 30 dias.

Para te ajudar nas compras no mercado temos o Vale Alimentação mensal e para sua alimentação diária temos o Vale Refeição ou Refeitório .

E o deslocamento para a empresa? Oferecemos Vale Transporte ou fretado .

Já pensou em comprar nossos produtos com desconto? Nós temos a Heistore , uma loja exclusiva para colaboradores.

Temos Paixão por aprender e pensando no seu desenvolvimento, oferecemos diversos cursos na nossa Universidade HEINEKEN , além de parcerias educacionais e programa de idiomas .

E para desenvolver ainda mais a nossa liderança temos o Be Leader – um programa interno exclusivo que acontece anualmente para fomentar o aprendizado e a conexão do nosso time de Líderes.

*conforme elegibilidade.

NÓS SOMOS HEINEKEN!

No Brasil, já crescemos muito e estamos em um novo momento ainda mais movidos pela paixão em sermos a melhor cervejaria para nosso time, parceiros, clientes, consumidores e toda a sociedade. Trabalhamos com marcas incríveis, que as pessoas amam, e com valores que direcionam um modelo de negócio vencedor.

Acreditamos no nosso #timedeestrelas e oferecemos um ambiente leve, informal e respeitoso para que todas as nossas pessoas se sintam confortáveis para ser quem são e, dessa forma, sejam protagonistas de suas carreiras. É assim que caminhamos diariamente em busca da realização do nosso sonho no Brasil: levar nossa estrela em cada coração e em cada copo brasileiro.

Para saber mais sobre o Grupo HEINEKEN Brasil e as nossas iniciativas em sustentabilidade, Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão, entre outros temas, acesse nosso site.

About Us

Zurich Insurance Company is a leading provider of insurance products and services, committed to delivering innovative solutions and exceptional customer service. If you are a talented and experienced Full-Stack Developer, passionate about creating intuitive and engaging user interfaces and have a strong background in Angular and React, we would love to hear from you.

So make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported, Love what you do. Work for us.

The opportunity: DATA ENGINEER

The Data Engineer will be responsible for leading and powering data-driven decisions and leveling-up the data and analytics tools of the Zurich organization. By leveraging new technology, the ZCAM data engineering team ensures that all stakeholders in the organization can efficiently access reliable and accurate data. Data engineers will develop, implement, and refine the standards, tools, and methodologies that make up the desired analysis environment within the organization. Their expertise will help create a strong data foundation within Zurich that keeps everyone informed and moving forward.

Responsibilities

  • Defining and implementing scalable and flexible data analytics architecture based on current and future business needs mainly utilizing Databricks platform
  • Build and optimize complex data pipelines, and ETL processes for processing large-scale datasets
  • Integration, consolidation, cleansing and structuring of large data sets to enable business insights, reporting and ML/AI use cases
  • Delivering business insights by consolidating various data sources to understand business performance (e.g. sales data, customer satisfaction data, digital analytics data)
  • Sourcing, collecting and researching new internal and open-source external data sets
  • Defining and implementing data governance processes
  • Plan and prepare data engineering and analysis work between technical teams
  • Engage with business stakeholders to prepare and coordinate data sharing and data transfer activities
  • Support deployment, monitoring and maintenance of ML/AI models

Requirements

  • University degree in physics, math, computer science or a related field
  • Professional experience in related role and/or demonstrated competency (projects) utilizing relevant technologies
  • Good understanding of concepts and technologies underpinning modern data platforms (storage, compute, etc.) and how they fit into the bigger picture
  • Experience in cloud technologies, data modelling and designing/implementing scalable and efficient ETL/ELT pipelines
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL
  • Understanding of ML/AI and MLOps challenges
  • Familiarity with Databricks is a plus
  • Understanding and experience in solving data governance challenges utilizing modern technology
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills including the ability to explain technical issues, solutions and results to a non-technical audience
  • Strong proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required, Spanish language skills are a plus

Additional Information

We look forward to receiving your online application.

Zurich wants to attract the best talent and we acknowledge that talents might not always be available full-time. At Zurich we will consider requests for flexible working. Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of ways. Please talk to us during the interview about the flexibility you may need.

title: Factory Mechanic
description:
Aker QRILL Company is a world leader in the sustainable production of krill-based products. We are dedicated to enhancing the nutritional value of feed for aquaculture and livestock and contributing to a more sustainable global food system. Our business has experienced consistent growth within the Aker BioMarine organization. In 2024 we were spun out as a stand-alone entity, and we remain a reputable company in the maritime industry known for a focus on operational excellence.

We are now looking for a Factory Mechanic who will work on board our vessels in Antarctica

Factory Mechanic

The Factory Mechanic reports to the Factory Manager and the Chief Engineer on board and is responsible for Repair and Maintenance (R&M) of all processing equipment, packing equipment and storage equipment in the factory department onboard the fishing vessel, making sure that all such equipment is in good working condition. He/she is a key member of the on-board factory team and coordinates the daily R&M work along with the factory mechanic assistant. Furthermore, the factory mechanic is responsible for follow-up of purchase orders, ensuring there are sufficient spare parts for the processing equipment onboard, making sure that all orders are in line with given budgets. The Factory Mechanic may also be set to repair other machinery and being involved in other R&M operations onboard the ship.

The position is not set to a specific vessel and may change during the season if required or by request from management.

The company has implemented a safety management system according to The International Safety Management Code (ISM) by IMO. All employed by Aker BioMarine Antarctic Services AS, shall know their responsibilities within this system.

Responsibility during operation

  • Repair and Maintenance (R&M) of on-board krill meal and krill oil plant
  • Perform preventive maintenance of factory equipment
  • Monitoring equipment wear, planning, performing, and reporting maintenance jobs and order spare parts for factory, using the ERP system TM Master
  • Coordinate daily R&M work to be performed by factory mechanic assistant
  • Prepare all orders and jobs linked to annual shipyard/lay-up along with Factory Manager
  • Main responsible and coordinator of factory R&M work during shipyard and lay-ups
  • Participate in other tasks as requested by Factory Manager or Chief Engineer
  • Assist factory team in production process
  • Keep inventory up to date at all time
  • Make reports as requested and required including weekly reports and handover

Professional qualifications:

Relevant technical and mechanical competence including welding skills. Experience in the operation and maintenance of rotating equipment such as centrifuges, gear boxes, pumps, electro motors etc. Knowledge of servicing processing equipment, steam, condensate and hydraulic systems is an advantage.

CV must reflect required qualifications specified.

Personal qualifications:

  • Desire for an offshore career
  • English language skills
  • Enjoys working in an international team
  • Appreciates new challenges, seeking new tasks and continuous improvements
  • Systematic and responsible with drive and self-motivation

We offer:

  • A safe and attractive workplace
  • Possibility for entrance into a fixed position on board
  • Fixed annual salary
  • A very good working environment on board
  • Pension and insurance scheme
  • 12/7 shift; 12 hours on, 12 hours off, 7 days a week for the entire rotation
  • Shift rotation: One shift on (ca three months incl. travels) and two shifts off, averaging 150 sea days per year and about 120 - 130 days off between trips. Travel to and from fishing ground is about one week each way at the beginning and the end of the rotation, using ports in Uruguay, Chile, and Falkland Islands for embarkation on cargo and passenger vessel, bringing crew to fishing vessels on fishing ground.

Location: Vessel/Antarctica

Travel and rotation

Crew changes are normally arranged in Montevideo, Punta Arenas and Puerto Williams. Rotation is approximately 8 weeks on and off but may deviate slightly due to operation.

Application and contact information

Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? Please don't hesitate to apply as we will be contacting candidates on an ongoing basis.

Please send your application letter and CV in either English or Norwegian via the application link. Questions may be directed to .

About Aker QRILL Company:

We develop ingredients for use in the aquaculture and animal feed markets, as well as deliver raw materials for production of human health supplements. Our value chain stretches from our vessels and sustainable krill harvesting operations in Antarctica, through our logistics hub in Montevideo, and all the way to customers around the world.

The Company operates a fleet of four vessels, including one cargo vessel and three fishing vessels, leading krill fishing within the Antarctic region. The three fishing vessels operate on the fishing grounds year-round, except for one month in October, which is dedicated to maintenance and repairs while the cargo vessel transports products and crew to and from the fishing grounds throughout the year.

Our offices are located in Fornebu and Ålesund, with the logistics base and product warehouse in Montevideo, Uruguay. We are about 500 employees globally, of which about 430 work on board our krill vessels in Antarctica. We are a diverse company with more than 25 nationalities, spread across all time zones and most continents. Together, we form an international, high performing, diverse and fun work environment.

Working with us means you appreciate diversity, are highly skilled within your field and can cope with unexpected situations. You enjoy a fast pace, tolerate quick decisions and continuously ongoing changes. You are a true team player who “chips in” when the situation requires so.

QRILL Aqua is a functional feed ingredient for shrimp, marine fish, and salmonids, increasing productivity in aquaculture - through improved growth, health and quality.

QRILL Pet is a functional ingredient for pet nutrition with documented health benefits for companion animals. Proven in numerous studies to benefit pet health, the omega-3s help maintain the health of the heart, kidneys, liver, joints, brain, eyes, skin and coat.

Why should you be part of our team?

You can expect hard work and a lot of fun and challenges. In return we promise you will be part of an exciting journey. If you show initiative and desire for more responsibility, we will give it to you and support you along the way. We strongly believe that our team of people want to do their best. All in the spirit of being the leading company in our industry and always striving to raise the bar.
