  • Inglês avançado.
  • Sólida trajetória em posições executivas na liderança comercial, preferencialmente no setor financeiro;
  • Expertise em produtos e serviços financeiros;
  • Visão estratégica aguçada, mentalidade analítica e foco em performance;
  • Capacidade de articulação institucional, negociação de alto nível e gestão de relacionamentos complexos;
  • Vivência com transformação digital, inovação em modelos de negócio e cultura orientada a dados será considerada um diferencial relevante.

Quais serão às suas principais responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como principal estrategista da área comercial, com profundo conhecimento do mercado, comportamento dos clientes e tendências do setor;
  • Definir, implementar e liderar a estratégia comercial da companhia, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos corporativos e metas de crescimento sustentável;
  • Gerir e expandir a carteira de clientes, promovendo relacionamento de longo prazo e soluções customizadas que agreguem valor;
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), assegurando o atingimento de metas de vendas, rentabilidade e satisfação dos clientes;
  • Identificar e liderar oportunidades estratégicas de negócios, incluindo parcerias, fusões e aquisições que acelerem o crescimento da companhia;

Na Serasa Experian, acreditamos que a diversidade é fundamental para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e inovador, onde todas as pessoas possam trocar experiências e expressar suas ideias. Por isso, contamos com diversas ações para promover um recrutamento inclusivo e apoiar no desenvolvimento profissional das nossas pessoas. title: GERENTE DE PRICING - MATRIZ - SÃO PAULO/SP
description:
Job description

Responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias de sortimento, organização de produtos e políticas de precificação nas lojas, alinhadas ao planejamento da empresa e ao comportamento do shopper, com foco na rentabilidade e na experiência do cliente. Atua na definição e gestão de preços competitivos, por meio da análise de mercado, acompanhamento da concorrência e desenvolvimento de índices de competitividade. Lidera programas de monitoramento de preços e envia informações estratégicas ao time comercial, contribuindo para a tomada de decisões assertivas e garantindo o posicionamento competitivo da marca.


Main responsibilities

  • Desenvolver, estruturar e implementar a estratégia de pricing da empresa, alinhada aos objetivos de rentabilidade, crescimento e posicionamento competitivo no mercado.
  • Gerenciar o sortimento e a organização dos produtos em loja de acordo com diretrizes estratégicas, comportamento do shopper e performance de categorias, visando aumento de conversão e lucratividade.
  • Monitorar continuamente os preços praticados pela concorrência, por meio de pesquisas de mercado, ferramentas de monitoramento e análise de dados, assegurando a competitividade da empresa.
  • Criar, manter e aprimorar indicadores de performance (KPIs) e índices de competitividade de preços, garantindo visibilidade e controle das ações de pricing.
  • Identificar oportunidades de reposicionamento de preços, elasticidade de demanda e mix de produtos, a fim de maximizar margens e volume de vendas.
  • Propor ajustes de preços com base em análises financeiras, comportamento do consumidor, tendências de mercado e estratégias da concorrência.
  • Apoiar o time comercial na definição de estratégias por categoria, faixa de preço e perfil de loja, promovendo ações coordenadas entre pricing, compras e operações.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento de campanhas promocionais e políticas de descontos, garantindo alinhamento com as metas de rentabilidade.
  • Liderar projetos de inovação na área de pricing, incluindo automação, uso de inteligência artificial e ferramentas analíticas para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Assegurar a integridade, consistência e atualização das bases de dados utilizadas nas análises e na precificação dos produtos.
  • Treinar e orientar equipes envolvidas nos processos de pricing, garantindo a aplicação correta das políticas e estratégias definidas.
  • Realizar apresentações gerenciais com diagnósticos, análises e recomendações para os diferentes níveis da liderança da empresa.

Requirements and skills

  • Superior Completo, preferencialmente nos cursos de Administração, Comunicação, Contabilidade, Gestão Financeira, Gestão Comercial;
  • Conhecimento Avançado no Pacote Office: Word, Ênfase em Excel, Power point;
  • Conhecimento de pesquisas em loja;
  • Entendimento de marketing;
  • Domínio - Processo de Gerenciamento de Categorias;
  • Conhecimento em precificação;
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de negociação.

Additional information

Modalidade 100% presencial - Vila Leopoldina - ZO/SP

  • Estacionamento no local
  • Vale Refeição
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica

PALO IT is a global technology consultancy that crafts tech as a force for good. We design, develop and scale digital and sustainable products and services to unlock value across the triple bottom line: people, planet, profit. We do the right thing, and we do it right. We're proud to be a World Economic Forum New Champion, and a B Corp-certified company.

We are small enough to care locally, big enough to deliver globally (5 continents, 18 offices, +650 experts from +50 nationalities)

Design and implement RESTful APIs and integrate with SOAP and HTTP-based web services.

Manage and optimize relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MySQL.

Write and maintain automated unit and integration tests to ensure code quality and functionality.

Ensure systems are capable of handling high performance and large-scale real-time processing needs.

3+ years of experience with Node.js for back-end and React for front-end development

Experience designing microservices or serverless architecture

Proficient with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL

Comfortable with Git and version control workflows

Experience building robust automated test suites (unit and integration)

Exposure to high-performance, real-time systems

Working knowledge of Python

Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools

Experience in event-driven architectures (RabbitMQ or similar messaging platforms)

Experience with observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus, etc.)

More About PALO IT

Deliver projects with a positive impact

Train 100% of our workforce on impact

Achieve B Corp certification among all our offices across the globe

Continuously measure & improve employee happiness

Our clients are amongst the world's most successful companies. We innovate with both established Fortune 1000s, SMEs and start-ups who aim to make an impact, become global leaders and address the world's most complex challenges.

You?

Global Payroll Compliance and Excellence Specialist

Do you know Bunge?

Distributed in more than 40 countries, a world leader in oilseed processing and one of the largest producers and suppliers of vegetable oils, fats, and proteins for more than two centuries, Bunge works to connect farmers to consumers to provide essential food, ingredients, and fuels for the world. With 117 years in Brazil, we have more than 100 units and are one of the main agribusiness and food companies, a leader in grain origination and soybean and wheat processing. In all our value chains, we promote our business while supporting the social and economic well-being of the communities where we operate.

We value the diversity of our teams and seek creative talents with team spirit and a desire to make a difference. In everything we do, we put our values into practice:
• Act as one team, promoting inclusion, collaboration, and respect;
• Seek excellence, being agile, innovative, and efficient;
• Do what is right, acting in a safe, ethical, and sustainable manner.

At Bunge, we value diversity in all its forms and work towards an inclusive and belonging culture with respect and equity. Here, everyone is welcome as they are!

Our company has a solid track record, and we are building a future full of opportunities! Be part of our team and follow your professional journey with us.

Role Purpose

Global Payroll Compliance and Excellence Manager is responsible for providing strategic direction and support on global payroll for approximately 23,000 employees in 44 countries across the globe (Asia, Americas, and Europe). This role is responsible for ensuring, in partnership with HR regional leaders and BBS, accurate, compliant, and efficient payroll processing across all regions, managing payroll policies, and enhancing payroll systems and processes. This manager will work closely with cross-functional teams and regional payroll teams to implement and support on global standards processes, maintain compliance with varying regulations, and drive continuous improvement within payroll operations and T&A harmonization/standardization. The position will also support on vendor management to ensure payroll accuracy and compliance in multiple countries

Main Accountabilities

  • Support developing and implementing global payroll strategies, policies, and best practices to ensure efficient, timely, accurate and compliant payroll operations.
  • Support Global Payroll Transformation and M&A´s integration.
  • Support Time & Absence Transformation.
  • Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to track payroll accuracy, efficiency and compliance, including payroll and tax reconciliation, identifying and recommending opportunities to improve tax-related processes and systems to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with international, federal, state, and local payroll regulations, including tax filings, labor laws, and reporting requirements.
  • Implement controls to mitigate risks associated with payroll processing, including data integrity, fraud prevention, and regulatory compliance.
  • Partner with internal and external auditors to address audit requirements and resolve any compliance issues.
  • Facilitate training and communication with regional payroll teams on policies, processes, and changes in payroll regulations.
  • Partner with HR global functions to build and implement global processes, e.g. payroll mobility control, salary publishing, bonus publishing and respective activities transition to BBS.
  • Establish partnerships with third party vendors to ensure effective service delivery, and support HR regional leaders on manage them

Knowledge and Skills

  • Make decisions aligned to Bunge’s global strategy, business needs and financial goals and explore new perspectives by driving innovation.
  • Cultivate strong relationships and networks, effectively influence others, and develop talent to excel in their current and future roles.
  • Develop data driven strategies aligned with Bunge’s priorities, energize others to action through clear and compelling communication.
  • Clear understanding of HR operational excellence, global payroll, organizational alignment
  • Strong communications and presentation skills, the ability to make the complex, detailed information clear and actionable, as well as strong influence management skills to the alignment and commitment
  • Excellent problem-solving and conflict resolution capability
  • Experience driving projects to a successful completion, and ability to work in a global environment
  • HR operations and payroll best practices and processes knowledge
  • Knowledge of labor legislation overall
  • GDPR (data privacy) knowledge

Education & Experience

  • Degree in business management, Human Resources or related discipline in an equivalent education
  • Experience with HR Operations, payroll and/or any other HR role
  • Experience with end-to-end M&A activities
  • Experience managing large vendors and contracts
  • Focus on customer service
  • Excellent written communication and numerical skills
  • Ability to work within tight and conflicting timeframes
  • Focus on accuracy, compliance and driving results
  • Ability to handle confidential information and sensitive matters
  • Fluent English language skill (Spanish is desired)

Na Comunidade de Pagamentos, o dia a dia é dinâmico e colaborativo. O ambiente é altamente tecnológico, com práticas ágeis, cultura DevOps e foco em observabilidade. A pessoa também participará de code reviews, desenho de soluções escaláveis e seguras, e contribuirá para a melhoria contínua da experiência dos nossos clientes. O trabalho é híbrido, com encontros presenciais às quartas e quintas-feiras.

  • Experiência sólida comJava(imprescindível);
  • Conhecimento emPython,KotlineGosão diferenciais.
  • Conhecimento emAWS(ECS, EC2, SQS, SNS, Lambda, DynamoDB).

  • Experiência comobservabilidade(Datadog ou Grafana).
  • Conhecimento emtestes automatizados(unitários, integrados e funcionais).
  • Familiaridade commetodologias ágeis,DevOps,infraestrutura como código (Terraform).
  • Capacidade de colaborar emdesenhos técnicose propor soluções modernas e resilientes.
  • Desejável: conhecimento emdesign patternscomo Circuit Breaker, Event Sourcing, Saga, CQRS.
  • Inglês intermediário.

  • Creatively brand and promote Patria’s culture, maximizing social media and digital presence for talent branding and engagement.

Main Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in program or project management within recruitment, early talent programs, or employer branding, preferably with exposure to both corporate and search firm environments.
  • Proven experience managing end-to-end recruitment processes, including partnership with external vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience in KPI management and data analytics, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and present findings to stakeholders.
  • Fluent in English; Spanish is a plus.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Knowledge of university recruiting cycles, early talent best practices, and employer branding strategies.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities in a structured, disciplined manner.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or data analytics tools is highly desirable.

At Patria, we believe that how we achieve our goals is as important as the results themselves. Our way of working is a key differentiator, helping us retain the best team, build long-term relationships, and generate superior returns. We are:

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Strategic Account Executive role at Canonical

Continue with Google Continue with Google

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Strategic Account Executive role at Canonical

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.
The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.
Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.
What your day will look like
  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events
Additional Skills Of Interest
  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Patria is, at its core, a resilient and entrepreneurial partnership that continually assesses the environment, identifies trends, and adapts quickly to capture new opportunities. Our team is made up of high performers who combine expertise with a hands-on approach, fostering trusting relationships with clients and delivering consistent results. For over 35 years, we have been recognized as a regional and sector specialist in alternative asset management, with a strong commitment to ethical values and long-lasting impact for all our stakeholders.

About the Role

We are seeking a Program Manager (Associate level) to lead and manage our Early Careers Recruitment, Trainee Programs, and Employer Branding projects. This role is pivotal in shaping Patria’s early talent pipeline and strengthening our employer brand across Latin America and beyond. You will partner closely with universities, internal stakeholders, and external vendors to attract, engage, and develop high-potential students and early career professionals who align with our long-term talent needs and organizational culture.

This position is based in our São Paulo office and follows a full in-person work model. We are looking for local talent!

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end management of early careers recruitment programs, including Patria Academy (internship and trainee programs), ensuring alignment between recruitment partners, hiring managers, HRBPs, and other stakeholders.
  • Design, implement, and continuously improve structured recruitment processes for early talent, from needs assessment and sourcing strategy to candidate selection, onboarding, and program engagement.
  • Oversee external recruitment consultancies, ensuring service-level quality, process adherence, and alignment with Patria’s priorities and values.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with universities, career centers, and student organizations to enhance Patria’s presence and attract top early career talent.
  • Drive employer branding initiatives focused on early careers, including digital campaigns, university events, and social media engagement to promote Patria’s culture and opportunities.
  • Provide comprehensive staffing support and market intelligence to management teams, leveraging leading-edge recruiting techniques and tools.
  • Own KPI management and data analytics for all early careers programs: define, track, and analyze key performance indicators (such as time to hire, cost to hire, diversity of hires, program conversion rates, and candidate experience metrics) to identify trends, measure program effectiveness, and drive data-driven decision making.
  • Prepare and present regular reports and actionable insights to leadership, recommending improvements based on data analysis.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies and processes, maintaining accurate records and influencing hiring managers regarding their compliance responsibilities.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders and HR partners, proactively engaging leadership teams to establish a common understanding of Talent Acquisition policies, processes, and service level agreements.
  • Creatively brand and promote Patria’s culture, maximizing social media and digital presence for talent branding and engagement.

Main Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in program or project management within recruitment, early talent programs, or employer branding, preferably with exposure to both corporate and search firm environments.
  • Proven experience managing end-to-end recruitment processes, including partnership with external vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience in KPI management and data analytics, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and present findings to stakeholders.
  • Fluent in English; Spanish is a plus.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Knowledge of university recruiting cycles, early talent best practices, and employer branding strategies.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities in a structured, disciplined manner.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or data analytics tools is highly desirable.

At Patria, we believe that how we achieve our goals is as important as the results themselves. Our way of working is a key differentiator, helping us retain the best team, build long-term relationships, and generate superior returns. We are:

Descubra a beleza da Amazônia, a riqueza da cultura paraense e a sofisticação da marca Tivoli em um destino encantador.

Sistema Fiep é sinônimo de fortalecimento da indústria. Trabalhamos de forma integrada, visando ser referência nacional no desenvolvimento industrial, no apoio ao associativismo e no atendimento eficiente.

Esta é a nossa missão: Promover, representar e defender a indústria paranaense, em busca da melhor competitividade e desenvolvimento sustentável.

Para você que deseja contribuir com o nosso propósito, de transformar o Paraná no melhor lugar para a indústria no Brasil, esta vaga pode ser sua!

Qual é a posição?

Vendedor I (Consultor de Vendas de Serviços) – RP 16875 Sistema Fiep (Fiep, Sesi, Senai e IEL)

Quais são os desafios e as principais responsabilidades?

  • Prospectar novas parcerias e potenciais clientes de negócios;
  • Contribuir para o aumento das vendas de todo o portfólio de produtos por meio da realização de visitas às empresas para a venda e fidelização de clientes;
  • Encaminhar as demandas de produtos/serviços, negociar preços, prazos e agenda junto aos técnicos e áreas responsáveis pelo atendimento aos clientes;

Job description

Dedicamo-nos a oferecer soluções de mobilidade que proporcionem experiências únicas por meio de nossos produtos e serviços. E isso só é possível porque temos uma equipe incrível , com brilho nos olhos e vontade de realizar!

É assim que fazemos acontecer! Inspirados pelo Poder dos Sonhos e movidos pelas crenças fundamentais da nossa Filosofia: #respeito ao indivíduo , #iniciativa , #igualdade e #confiança , temos contribuído para tornar a Honda uma empresa única, inovadora e desejada pela sociedade.

A Honda valoriza a Diversidade e Inclusão e tem um olhar que engloba o respeito e aceitação das pessoas por meio do reconhecimento das diferenças e da singularidade de cada um, podendo referir-se a gênero, raça, etnia, nacionalidade, idade, orientação sexual, deficiência, característica física, crença religiosa, perspectiva política, status social entre outros.

“Somos uma empresa focada no ser humano, movida pelo sonho de criar e pelo espírito dos desafios” Soichiro Honda

Se você se identifica conosco e deseja fazer parte deste time, vamos iniciar esta jornada!

Main responsibilities

Seu dia a dia transita por atividades multidisciplinares e desafios tais como:

  • Atendimento consultivo às concessionarias;
  • Responsável pelo resultado de vendas de motos e acessórios a nível Brasil;
  • Análise de indicadores e elaboração de planos de ação para atingimento de metas;
  • Elaboração de reports e apresentações para gerencia e diretoria.

Requirements and skills

O que buscamos em você:

  • Experiência em relacionamento com clientes e/ou fornecedores, viagens comerciais e negociações comerciais;
  • Superior completo em Marketing, Administração, Engenharias, Economia e correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • CNH B;
  • Pacote Office intermediário.

O que será considerado um diferencial:

  • Cursos complementares: Atendimento a clientes, Técnicas de Negociação, Gestão de Negócios, Gestão Comercial;
  • Experiência em reporte e análise indicadores através de Power BI, Qlikview e/ou Tableau;
  • Experiência no setor automotivo.

Additional information

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Honda São Paulo (próximo ao shopping Morumbi). Vaga no modelo presencial de trabalho.

Informações adicionais:

Nos preocupamos com o seu bem-estar, por isso oferecemos os seguintes benefícios, os quais revalidaremos em sua jornada, pois variam de acordo com a localidade:

  • Nossa Jornada de Trabalho tem carga horária flexível e banco de horas para usufruir sempre que precisar;
  • Oferecemos Vale Refeição, Van Honda x Metrô, Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, Vale Transporte, Auxilio Creche para as mamães, estacionamento, Wellhub e a PreviHonda;
  • Programas de desenvolvimento e conexão tais como Saúde e Bem-estar;
  • Descontos em nossos produtos Honda;
  • Bônus anual;

E um pouquinho a mais sobre nós:

Presente no Brasil desde 1971, a Moto Honda da Amazônia Ltda é atualmente a maior fabricante de motos do país, com mais de 27 milhões de unidades produzidas em Manaus (AM). Desde 2001, a empresa produz também motores estacionários e motobombas, além de comercializar a linha de motores e máquinas no país.

Em 1992, com a criação da Honda Automóveis do Brasil Ltda. , a empresa entrou no mercado automotivo brasileiro.

Faz parte do grupo também a Honda Serviços Financeiros , que reúne o Consórcio Nacional Honda , a corretora de Seguro Honda e o Banco Honda que facilitam o acesso dos clientes aos produtos da marca.

Durante esses anos a empresa também inaugurou Centros Educacionais de Trânsito, de Treinamento Técnico, de Distribuição de Peças e de Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento, além do seu próprio parque eólico no sul do país.

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
Join to apply for the Strategic Account Executive role at Canonical

Continue with Google Continue with Google

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Strategic Account Executive role at Canonical

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.
The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.
Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.
What your day will look like
  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events
Additional Skills Of Interest
  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job Description:

The Lead Generation Specialist for Brazil, reporting to the Associate Director of Commercial Operations, will focus primarily on the entire BIDs process, since capture of "editais" until, will prepare all the documentation to participate on the BID process, and participate in the BID session. After the BID, this person needs to follow the process until we receive the Purchase Order. Also, this person will focus on expanding our reach within the Brazilian market, generating new contacts and leads for the sales team, leading to new customers, business relationships and sales opportunities.

The ideal candidate will have knowledge of bidding laws and resource assembly and an ability to work both independently and collaboratively on problems of diverse scope is imperative to support the achievement of national sales objectives.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the whole bidding process since capture of "editais" until, will prepare all the documentation to participate on the BID process, and participate in the BID session.
  • Research, analyze and identify Brazilian researchers and groups that might be interested in or benefit from next-generation sequencing.
  • Lead prospecting activities to identify new customers within the Brazil market.
  • Identify new end users within existing customer accounts to increase sales opportunities.
  • Generate lists of qualified target prospects for outbound marketing campaigns.
  • Maintain information within lead databases and customer relationship management (CRM) platform.
  • Develop and execute strategies to reach out to potential customers and collaborate with the sales and commercial development teams to create effective lead generation campaigns and streamlined customer communication plans.
  • Evaluate prospect’s needs and goals prior to handing leads off to the sales team.
  • Track and report on lead generation performance metrics and continuously refine your approach to optimize results.

Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive list, of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs.

Position Requirements:

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or an advanced degree without experience; or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience in bidding process is required.
  • Experience in lead generation/prospecting in genomics, life sciences, pharma, medical device or related fields preferred.
  • Knowledge of genetics, genomics, bioinformatics and related applications and techniques (eg. PCR, NGS) and knowledge of related market in Brazil.
  • Ability to conduct market research for targeted leads.
  • Highly self-motivated, adaptable, independent individual who is a quick learner, with excellent project management skills and attention to detail.
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills and ability to work as a team player in a dynamic, fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Experience with CRM (Salesforce) and lead nurturing strategies preferred but not required.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Advanced English (preferred).
  • Hybrid position
